$comment: Print token source of truth for The Art and Science of Headphone Design. The `web` block mirrors the light-theme --mp-* tokens in src/styles/theme.css 1:1 (do NOT redesign these — they are the bridge to the website). The `print` block is the new layer for Claude Design to FILL IN (values shown are starting suggestions, not final). Keep web names and print names in 1:1 correspondence so the systems never drift.

sans.stack: Schibsted Grotesk Variable, Schibsted Grotesk, sans-serif
sans.license: SIL OFL 1.1 — cleared for print embedding

body.stack: Source Serif 4 Variable, Source Serif 4, Georgia, serif

mono.stack: JetBrains Mono Variable, JetBrains Mono, monospace
mono.role: technical chrome — eyebrows, captions, spec blocks, folios, diagram labels

$notes.accent: Vivid RGB orange. OUT OF GAMUT in CMYK — dulls toward brick. Load-bearing: every measured trace, part number, difficulty mark, link. Needs a print build (see print.accent_cmyk).
$notes.contrast-split: Text-bearing orange uses the darker accent-hover (#c2410c, 5.2:1 on white); raw accent (#ea580c, 3.6:1) is for non-text marks only. Preserve this split in print.

print.$instructions: Claude Design: fill these in. CMYK builds as {c,m,y,k} 0–100.

baseline.$note: all leading a multiple of the 14pt baseline; headings snap to grid

rich_black_cmyk.$note: for the large dark 'Daily Driver' bands so they don't print muddy

figure_numbering.target: chapter-scoped 'Fig. 4.2', driving a List of Figures
